$sources: Measures and colours: the as-built pond's forget-me-not patches (windows/Source/MuseeVision/Salon/SalonPond.cpp, ForgetMeNots): 10-15 stems a patch, 3-5 oblong leaves 30-45 mm by 9-13 mm up each, sprays of 5-9 flowers 8.5-10.5 mm across, sky blue, the youngest pink buds in the coil.

The species: Myosotis scorpioides L., water forget-me-not: stems ascending from a creeping base, to about 0.45 m; flowers 4-10 mm, sky blue with a yellow eye, in a coiled (scorpioid) cyme, pink in bud (C. Stace, New Flora of the British Isles, 4th ed., Cambridge 2019, Boraginaceae).
name: Myosotis scorpioides
note: Stem heights are from the soil of the shelf, 0.12 m under the water: the sprays stand 0.07-0.19 m above it, as built. In flower from Lixia to Dashu.
